conf.description: Zeek / Corelight http / csv-file (TSV ASCII writer): header-driven tab split (fixed default column order) then logs-zeek.http@custom-equivalent ECS mapping. Direct route, no guard hop.

conf.comment: Zeek http.log (TSV/ASCII writer) -> logs-zeek.http. Splits on tab per the Zeek 6.0/7.0 LTS default http.log column order (fixed list, see README gap). Cleartext HTTP only. MANDATORY per recommendations.direct.cribl: the password column is dropped immediately after parsing, before any other function runs - it is a real TSV column carrying a cleartext Basic-Auth credential and there is no guard hop on this direct route to catch it later. url.original is assembled from host+uri (origin-form, no scheme/authority); status_code buckets into event.outcome; event.dataset=zeek.http per the route note.

functions.description: discard Zeek ASCII-writer header/meta lines (#separator, #fields, #types, #path, #open, #close, ...) - they carry no event data

conf.code: (function(){var HEADER=["ts", "uid", "id_orig_h", "id_orig_p", "id_resp_h", "id_resp_p", "trans_depth", "method", "host", "uri", "referrer", "version", "user_agent", "origin", "request_body_len", "response_body_len", "status_code", "status_msg", "info_code", "info_msg", "tags", "username", "password", "proxied", "orig_fuids", "orig_filenames", "orig_mime_types", "resp_fuids", "resp_filenames", "resp_mime_types"];var ARRAY_COLS={"proxied": true, "tags": true, "resp_filenames": true, "resp_mime_types": true, "orig_filenames": true, "orig_mime_types": true, "orig_fuids": true, "resp_fuids": true};var vals=__e['_raw']?__e['_raw'].split('\t'):[];for(var i=0;i<HEADER.length;i++){var name=HEADER[i];var v=vals[i];if(v===undefined||v==='-'){continue;}if(v==='(empty)'){v='';}__e[name]=(ARRAY_COLS[name]&&v!=='')?v.split(','):v;}})();

functions.description: split the tab-delimited data line per Zeek's default http.log column order (id.orig_h etc. renamed to id_orig_h etc. to avoid a dotted raw field name as a path-based target); tags/proxied/orig_fuids/orig_filenames/orig_mime_types/resp_fuids/resp_filenames/resp_mime_types are set_separator ',' vectors and become arrays here

MANDATORY security drop: http.password is a cleartext Basic-Auth credential column in TSV http.log per the data map notes - remove it before any other function can reference, log, or forward it. Never a mapping target.
batch rename of clean 1:1 mapped fields with no value transform
implement every partial/unmapped transform from the data map, set _time from ts, tag event.dataset, then remove the now-superseded raw columns
